sentences.text:
Digambar Shrirang Shingade vs State Of Maharashtra And Anr
on 21 June, 2023

Bench: Nitin W. Sambre, R. N. Laddha
 1/2
 6.Wp.1348.202
 In The High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Writ Petition No. 1348 Of 2022
Digambar Shrirang Shingade .. Petitioner
 Vs.
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. .. Respondents
Mr. R. V. Bansode for the petitioner Mrs. S. D. Shinde, App for the respondent - State Coram :
Nitin W. Sambre & R. N. Laddha, Jj Dated : 21st June, 2023 P.C.:
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Bombay
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard, Mr. Bansode, learned counsel for the Petitioner and Mrs. Shinde, learned APP for the Respondent-State.

2. According to learned counsel for the Petitioner, genesis of the offence being crime no. 77 of 2018 punishable u/s. 420, 193(2), 199, 200, 463, 464, 467, 468, 471 of IPC and that of Crime No. 125 of 2018 punishable u/s. 420, 464, 465, 467, 468, 471 of IPC are same that is tampering with the gram panchayat record.
3. As such, according to learned counsel for the Petitioner merely because there are two different complaints, two different charge-sheets ought not to have been registered against the Petitioner.
He would rely on the principle of double jeopardy.

We deem it appropriate to direct the Additional SP, Satara to file his Affidavit dealing with the aforesaid issue, as prima facie we are of the view that the Senior PI of the Police Station ought to have looked into the same and there appears to be failure on the part of the Senior PI of the police to look into the same.
5.
We expect the Affidavit of Additional SP, Satara by 10/07/2023.
Ad-interim relief, if any, granted earlier to continue till then.
